title: The Golf Buggy (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan warm baritone male vocal absurdist true story Australian family comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, dry and expectant]
December 2025.
The Vines Resort.
Jack accelerated by accident.
Joel was going through the gate.

[Verse 1]
It was a golf buggy
Not a car
Not a truck
A golf buggy
Driven by someone called Jack
Who accidentally accelerated
Into Joel
Who was going through the gate
At home
From the Vines Resort
As one does
On a December evening
In Perth

[Verse 2]
Mum texted Corey:
Joel's in hospital
Suspected broken leg ankle
Jack accelerated by accident
Ran him into the woodpile as he was going through the gate
He's high as a kite
That last bit was the medication
Not the buggy

[Chorus]
The golf buggy
Jack behind the wheel
The golf buggy
Joel through the gate
The golf buggy
December twenty-twenty-five
The golf buggy
Broken leg
The golf buggy
Emoji laughing crying
The golf buggy
That's Joel
Three laughing faces
From hospital

[Bridge - spoken, completely level]
He texted his brother from the hospital.
"Broken leg. Jack run me over in my golf cart."
Then three emojis.
The laughing ones.
All three of them.
Not one.
Three.
That's Joel Aaron McIvor.
In hospital.
With a broken leg.
Sending three laughing emojis.
From the golf cart incident.
At the Vines.

[Verse 3]
He sent the x-rays later
Full set
Images omitted but the bones were not
The ankle, the leg
The whole December situation
Corey said it looked like his own scans
The family has specific bones
Apparently

[Chorus reprise]
The golf buggy
Broken leg
The golf buggy
Three laughing emojis
The golf buggy
Joel
The golf buggy
That all you got, Jack?

[Outro - piano alone, warm and dry]
Jack
We hope you are well
The gate is still there
The buggy presumably also
Joel is still kicking
He said so himself
Laughing
From hospital
